chk.text: O-Kagachi, the Great Old Serpent, is enraged when Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out its heart, casting it as a stone disk, and this starts the Kami War.
In the war's twentieth year O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai, and the two merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place, and his death merges the two realms.

bok.text: O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo, where warriors who turn to face him die of awe, and he descends on the castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins it.
Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, and O-Kagachi senses its absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.

sok.text: At Jukai, Konda arrives and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi, who manifests all eight heads, while Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who takes the name Kyodai.
Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads, and his death breaks down the barrier, merging the spirit and mortal realms.
